desc.en: A composition-first website builder based on shadcn/ui blocks. The free plan lets you connect your own custom domain, and includes unlimited pages, multi-language support, blog, forms, and hosting.
desc.zh: 基于 shadcn/ui 区块、以组合优先的网站构建器。免费套餐允许绑定你自己的自定义域名，包含不限数量的页面、多语言支持、博客、表单和托管。

desc.en: A free installable Web app for drawing SVGs and exporting in SVG, PNG, jpeg, and other formats.
desc.zh: 免费的可安装 Web 应用，用于绘制 SVG 并导出为 SVG、PNG、jpeg 等格式。

desc.en: Favicon API. AI-based discovery for domains without icons or even without web servers. Free tier includes 500,000 requests per month with attribution.
desc.zh: 网站图标（Favicon）API。基于 AI 为没有图标甚至没有 Web 服务器的域名发现图标。免费套餐每月 500,000 次请求，需注明出处。

desc.en: Generate an entire year's worth of unique icons in a single click, absolutely FREE
desc.zh: 一键生成一整年的独特图标，完全免费。

desc.en: Free online design tool to create visual content.
desc.zh: 免费在线设计工具，用于创作视觉内容。

desc.en: Offers a well-crafted admin dashboard & and UI kits designed to simplify and speed up modern web development.
desc.zh: 提供精心制作的管理后台仪表板和 UI 套件，旨在简化并加速现代 Web 开发。

desc.en: A free online drawing document web page with free save to local and export support.
desc.zh: 免费的在线绘图文档网页，支持免费保存到本地和导出。

desc.en: Online, collaborative design tool for teams; free tier includes unlimited files and viewers with a max of 2 editors and three projects.
desc.zh: 面向团队的在线协作设计工具；免费套餐包含不限数量的文件和查看者，最多 2 名编辑者和 3 个项目。

desc.en: A fully customizable product adoption platform for building onboarding and user engagement experiences. Free for up to 250 monthly tracked users.
desc.zh: 完全可自定义的产品采用平台，用于构建新手引导和用户互动体验。免费支持每月最多 250 名被追踪用户。

desc.en: Create interactive and clickable demos of your website or app. Free with unlimited demos and unlimited views.
desc.zh: 为你的网站或应用创建可交互、可点击的演示。免费，演示数量和浏览次数均不限。

desc.en: Generate, edit, and publish beautiful websites and landing pages for your startup. All without code. The free tier allows you to have one website, fully customizable and published on the web.
desc.zh: 为你的初创公司生成、编辑和发布精美的网站和落地页。全程无需代码。免费套餐允许拥有 1 个完全可自定义并发布到网上的网站。

desc.en: Free cloud image hosting.
desc.zh: 免费云端图片托管。

desc.en: Company logo API with 44M+ brands that's as easy as calling a URL. First 10,000 API calls are free.
desc.zh: 公司 logo API，覆盖超过 4,400 万个品牌，调用就像访问 URL 一样简单。前 10,000 次 API 调用免费。

desc.en: Design, prototyping, and collaboration, free plan limited to one user and project.
desc.zh: 设计、原型制作与协作，免费套餐限 1 名用户和 1 个项目。

desc.en: Unlimited mind maps for free and store them in the cloud. Your mind maps are available everywhere, instantly, from any device.
desc.zh: 免费创建不限数量的思维导图并存储在云端。你的思维导图可在任何设备上即时、随处访问。

desc.en: Mockplus iDoc is a powerful design collaboration & handoff tool. Free Plan includes three users and five projects with all features available.
desc.zh: Mockplus iDoc 是强大的设计协作与交付工具。免费套餐含 3 名用户和 5 个项目，所有功能均可用。

desc.en: A Free, Advanced online design editor with Adobe Photoshop UI supporting PSD, XCF & Sketch formats (Adobe Photoshop, Gimp and Sketch App).
desc.zh: 免费的高级在线设计编辑器，具有 Adobe Photoshop 风格的 UI，支持 PSD、XCF 和 Sketch 格式（Adobe Photoshop、Gimp 和 Sketch App）。

desc.en: A fast, easy-to-use, robust web design tool and page builder that integrates into your codebase. Build responsive pages or complex components; optionally extend with code; and publish to production sites and apps.
desc.zh: 快速、易用、可靠的 Web 设计工具和页面构建器，可集成到你的代码库中。构建响应式页面或复杂组件；可选择用代码扩展；并发布到生产环境的网站和应用。

desc.en: Create fully interactive UI prototypes without coding. The free tier is available when the free trial ends. The free tier includes one user, one project, five prototypes, 100MB of online storage, and a preview of the proto.io app.
desc.zh: 无需编码即可创建完全可交互的 UI 原型。免费试用结束后可使用免费套餐。免费套餐含 1 名用户、1 个项目、5 个原型、100MB 在线存储以及 proto.io 应用预览。

desc.en: Quant Ux is a prototyping and design tool. - It's completely free and also open source.
desc.zh: Quant Ux 是一款原型制作与设计工具。——完全免费且开源。

desc.en: Preview your theme changes across different components and layouts.
desc.zh: 在不同组件和布局中预览你的主题更改。

desc.en: Create product mockups, 200 free mockups.
desc.zh: 创建产品模型，提供 200 个免费模型。

desc.en: Free search engine for 312K+ open-source SVG icons with ready-to-use SVG, React, Vue, HTML, and CSS code.
desc.zh: 免费的开源 SVG 图标搜索引擎，收录超过 31.2 万个图标，提供即用型 SVG、React、Vue、HTML 和 CSS 代码。

desc.en: Low-code Front-end Design & Development Platform. TeleportHQ is the collaborative front-end platform to instantly create and publish headless static websites. Three free projects, unlimited collaborators, and free code export.
desc.zh: 低代码前端设计与开发平台。TeleportHQ 是协作式前端平台，可即时创建并发布无头静态网站。3 个免费项目，协作者数量不限，代码导出免费。

desc.en: Effortless landing page builder with hosting. One website for free.
desc.zh: 轻松易用的落地页构建器，含托管服务。免费创建 1 个网站。

desc.en: WYSIWYG website builder for tailwindcss-based designs. Free for non-commercial usage.
desc.zh: 基于 tailwindcss 设计的所见即所得网站构建器。非商业用途免费。

desc.en: WYSIWYG website builder with animations and website hosting. Free for two projects.
desc.zh: 所见即所得的网站构建器，带动画和网站托管。免费支持 2 个项目。

desc.en: Open-source alternative to Webflow. The free plan offers unlimited websites on their domain. Five websites with custom domains. Ten thousand page views/month. 2 GB asset storage.
desc.zh: Webflow 的开源替代品。免费套餐在其域名上提供不限数量的网站、5 个绑定自定义域名的网站、每月 1 万次页面浏览和 2 GB 资产存储。

desc.en: Collaborative flowcharts, wireframes, sticky notes and mind maps. Create up to 4 free boards.
desc.zh: 协作式流程图、线框图、便签和思维导图。最多免费创建 4 个看板。

desc.en: Designer and developer collaboration platform. Show designs, assets, and style guides. Free for one project.
desc.zh: 设计师与开发者协作平台。展示设计、资产和样式指南。1 个项目免费。

desc.en: Download High Quality Free and Premium Admin dashboard template created with Angular, React, VueJs, NextJS, and NuxtJS! HTML Themes and UI Kits to create your applications faster!
desc.zh: 下载使用 Angular、React、VueJs、NextJS 和 NuxtJS 创建的高质量免费与高级管理后台仪表板模板！HTML 主题和 UI 套件助你更快构建应用！

desc.en: Selected high quality, modern design, professional and easy-to-use Free Admin Dashboard Template,
desc.zh: 精选的高质量、设计现代、专业且易用的免费管理后台仪表板模板。

desc.en: High-Quality Free and Premium Admin Dashboard and Website Templates created with Angular, Bootstrap, React, VueJs, NextJS, and NuxtJS!
desc.zh: 使用 Angular、Bootstrap、React、VueJs、NextJS 和 NuxtJS 创建的高质量免费与高级管理后台及网站模板！
